title: "Agent Odyssey"

A Blight spreads across the land: plausible-but-false knowledge that grows when nobody checks it.
Walk the map with the arrow keys (or WASD) and press Enter on a gate. The gold **▶ NEXT** marker is the suggested next stop. Other **OPEN** zones can be visited in any order.
